experiment: E66 frozen NeuroShield-FM trial embeddings with normalized prototypes

foundation.positions: MNE standard_1005 metres through official names_norm_to_ref_pos3d; model coord_scale from metadata
foundation.known_pretraining_overlap: No BrainPrint dataset is listed in the official repository; TUH-EEG, DVS-rsEEG and PREDICT are listed

preprocess.scope: trial-local only; no batch or cross-trial statistics
preprocess.robust_scale: per channel over the full 4 s: subtract median and divide by 1.4826*MAD, with RMS fallback near zero
preprocess.resample: GPU FFT band-limit and zero-padded Fourier resampling from 300 Hz/1200 to 500 Hz/2000
preprocess.windows: four non-overlapping 500-sample windows; mean of four L2-normalized window embeddings followed by L2 normalization
preprocess.official_amplitude_protocol_deviation: BrainPrint amplitude units are unconfirmed, so robust unitless scaling replaces the official absolute microvolt QC/clipping

identity.model: class means of frozen fit-block trial embeddings, each L2-normalized; no WCCN and no encoder training
identity.confidence: maximum prototype cosine similarity; larger means more likely known
identity.decision: if max_cosine < tau_low output 0, otherwise output argmax identity
identity.threshold_source: clean known continuous blocks only; no unknown or Test threshold tuning

protocol.source: E58/E65 ten inner runs and E54 subject roles, without CNN or logSPD branches
protocol.roles: outer_unknown=4, enrolled=8, unused_oe_only=4, calibration_eval_unknown=4; pairwise disjoint
protocol.aggregation: two inner runs averaged within each outer group, then five outer groups averaged
protocol.final20: fit <=60%, calibration 60-70% for q02/q05, sanity 70-80%; >80% unused

test_gate.if_any_clean_gate_fails: Test=N/A; do not read Test and do not create predictions
test_gate.all_train_gates_claim: false: E66 does not run the attack suite or claim RA/ASafeR gates

test_audit.session_read_timing: only after all predictions and CSV are written

numerical_check.tolerance_reason: CUDA FP16 GEMM/attention kernels vary with batch size; permutation must remain exact and final labels must remain identical

reporting.AUC: clean pseudo-unknown detection AUROC using max prototype cosine; larger means known
reporting.AUPR: unknown-class AUPR using negative max cosine
reporting.F1: registered identity macro-F1 direct and with rejection; unknown-class F1 and joint macro-F1 separately
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train session1 pseudo-unknown subjects and continuous within-session file blocks only; not cross-session or official Test truth evidence
